symptom: report architecture (and the catalog's GRAPH_MODULE_CYCLES behind module_cycles()) shows a false 9-module domain cycle through the module that holds a task queue
cause: the `queue` ref runs from the queue to the flow it runs and was counted as module use, so the queue's module 'depended on' every flow it runs; no edge recorded the caller's use of the queue. `by_name` (a constant naming a flow) was counted the same way
insight: A reference kind added for reachability (so a flow is not dead) is not automatically a dependency: ask which way the use runs before a kind enters module edges. One shared list (RefKindsNotModuleUse) keeps the catalog and the report agreeing
